Definition: of Chaldee origin (compare H1538); the skull; Golgotha, a knoll near Jerusalem:--Golgotha.
BiblicalUsage: The word Golgothâ carries the sense of Golgotha. In Matthew 27:33, the text says "And when they were come unto a place called Golgotha." In Mark 15:22, the text says "And they bring him unto the place Golgotha."
TheologicalSignificance: Golgothâ convinces me that salvation is God's work from first to last — we receive it, we do not achieve it. That is why I keep this word in mind when I read those passages — it carries more than its size suggests.
